description: Run the tests; on failure search the error and apply a fix, then re-verify. The verdict is the test process's exit code, not the agent's word. Green tests -> commit (asks first); out of attempts -> escalate. Чинит падающие тесты циклом «запустил - поправил - проверил».

nodes.instruction: Run the test suite; the exit code decides.
Search the failing test error plus the library versions.
Commit the green state (asks the person first).
